title: Written Termination Notice under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
**Subject.** These provisions settle the early termination fee for a written termination notice the employer gives to take effect on the earliest termination date its notice period allows, under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. The termination notice is the employer's own act: the support agent works out and quotes the fee, and the authorized employer contact signs and gives the notice personally, the fee being billed on the day the notice is accepted.

**Billing of the fee.** An early termination fee line is billed when the program terminates before the end of its current term, and it is never billed at the end of a term for which notice was given in time; for a notice given to take effect on the earliest termination date its amount is fixed and billed on the day the notice is accepted as these provisions settle it, a fee that comes to zero being recorded with the notice and not billed, and for any other notice it is billed on the final invoice at the tier's early termination fee months of the monthly platform fee, limited to the whole calendar months from the termination date to the renewal date. Where the early termination fee comes to zero, the termination notice is recorded and no early termination fee line is billed, a line that comes to zero not being billed.

**When the notice is recorded.** The early termination fee is billed, and the termination notice recorded with it, only after, where the remittance return booked most recently is the only remittance return booked that day and the deduction schedule it names carries no employer-liable shortfall notice, that schedule carries the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in once its late-charge grace has passed. Read against the records: while such a schedule is past its late-charge grace and does not yet carry the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in, neither the fee nor the notice is booked.

## Giving the notice

The notice is given with `sign_termination_notice_c67c1163`, a tool of the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the authorized employer contact) signs and runs it personally, accepting the early termination fee quoted for it. One call records today as the termination notice date, moves the agreement to terminating status, and bills the early termination fee as one invoice line for the current calendar month with the due date given, raising the program charges the employer currently owes by that fee; a fee of zero is recorded with the notice and no fee line is billed. The employer sees the agreement as terminating and any fee on its program statement.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, as given to the employer contact by the support agent from the agreement record |
| `early_termination_fee` | the early termination fee accepted with the notice, in US dollars, a number with 2 decimal places as quoted by the support agent; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent by the tool |
| `due_date` | the date the early termination fee is due, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time or time zone, as given by the support agent; never empty |

## Return

A single text line: "Notice recorded <notice date>: agreement <agreement_id> is terminating; early termination fee <amount> USD billed as line <line reference>, due <due_date>; program charges owed now <amount> USD." The notice date is YYYY-MM-DD, the amounts are US dollars with two decimals, the line reference is the new billing entry reference number, and the last figure is the agreement's program charges owed with any fee included. When the fee is zero the line reads "Notice recorded <notice date>: agreement <agreement_id> is terminating; no early termination fee is billed; program charges owed now <amount> USD." A receipt line beginning with "Notice recorded" means the notice and any fee are booked.
